第 42 章 How to Conduct an Autonomy-Support Meeting如何主持自主支持会议

Matthew Philip / 马修·菲利普

— 第 127 页 —

The fifth principle of the Agile Manifesto encourages us to "Build projects around motivated individuals, give them the environment and support they need, and trust them to get the job done." As managers, one of the ways we can fulfill that principle is by providing autonomy-support meetings for the people we support.

敏捷宣言的第五原则鼓励我们「围绕有动力的个人构建项目，给他们需要的环境和支持，信任他们完成工作。」作为经理，我们实现这个原则的方式之一是为我们支持的人提供自主支持会议。

An autonomy-support meeting is a one-on-one meeting in which the manager, taking a servant-leader stance, helps an employee by clearing a path and clarifying what problems need to be solved but not how to solve them. Rather than telling the employee what to do, the manager asks what they can do to support the employee's goals in alignment with the team's and organization's goals. Here are some ways in which a manager can do this:

自主支持会议是一种一对一会议，经理以服务型领导者的姿态，通过清除障碍、明确需要解决什么问题（但不怎么解决）来帮助员工。不是告诉员工做什么，而是问他们可以做什么来支持员工与团队和组织目标一致的目标。以下是经理可以做到的一些方式：

  • Seeing issues from the employee's point of view从员工的角度看问题
  • Giving meaningful feedback给出有意义的反馈
  • Receiving feedback from the employee接受员工的反馈
  • Providing choice over what to do and how to do it提供做什么和怎么做的选择权
  • Encouraging the employees to take on new projects or roles鼓励员工承担新项目或角色
  • Making clear the team and organizational goals明确团队和组织目标

The dynamic should be one in which the traditional organizational structure is flipped upside-down. That is, rather than the traditional dynamic of the employee "working for" the manager, in the autonomy-support meeting, the servant-leader has the mindset of "working for" the employee. In this way, the manager typically doesn't give the employee to-do items but rather takes their own to-do list from the employee.

这种动态应该是传统组织结构被颠倒过来的。也就是说，不是员工「为」经理工作的传统动态，在自主支持会议中，服务型领导者有「为」员工工作的心态。这样，经理通常不给员工待办事项，而是从员工那里拿自己的待办清单。

Autonomy-support meetings are an opportunity for the employee to give feedback on how their manager can help the employee realize career goals in the organization. The meeting can be scheduled by the employee or someone acting as the employee's advocate. Multiple managers might attend the meeting, depending on which ones the employee feels are vital and able to help.

自主支持会议是员工就经理如何帮员工在组织中实现职业目标提供反馈的机会。会议可以由员工或充当员工倡导者的人安排。多个经理可能参加，取决于员工觉得哪些经理重要且能帮忙。

— 第 128 页 —

As for topics, it's whatever the employee needs managers to do in order for the employee to do their job better or reach goals. This might be a request for a different project or role switch, more time to explore a particular skill or technology or simply clearer vision or expectations set. Premised on the manager's commitments to the employee, the employee has the right to ask the manager for support in various career-development goals, including timelines for when those things would occur.

至于话题，就是员工需要经理做什么来让员工更好地工作或达成目标。这可能是请求换项目或换角色、更多时间探索特定技能或技术、或者只是更清晰的愿景或期望。基于经理对员工的承诺，员工有权要求经理在各种职业发展目标上提供支持，包括这些事情何时发生的时间线。

Questions that you as a manager might want to ask:

作为经理你可能想问的问题：

  • How can I help you realize your goals in the next year?我怎么帮你明年实现目标？
  • By when would you like me to achieve these things for you?你希望我什么时候为你做到这些？
  • In what areas have I failed to help you in the past, and how can I improve?我过去在哪些方面没有帮到你？我怎么改进？
  • What kind of things would help you feel more engaged?什么样的事情会帮你更有参与感？
  • How can I help smooth your path toward mastery of certain skills?我怎么帮你铺平掌握某些技能的道路？
  • What does success look like for you, and how can I help you succeed?对你来说成功是什么样的？我怎么帮你成功？

As a manager, I commit to you as an employee:

作为经理，我向你这个员工承诺：

  • Meet with you as often as you need (and at least semi-annually) to personally discuss how I can provide autonomy support, to the extent desired by you.按你需要的频率（至少半年一次）和你见面，亲自讨论我怎么提供你希望程度的自主支持。
  • Help you prioritize your professional development and not merely view your employment as a matter of billability.帮你优先考虑职业发展，而不只是把你的雇佣看作计费时间的问题。
  • Be transparent about the organization's goals and work with you to align your goals with them to support your career progression within the organization.对组织目标保持透明，和你一起让你的目标与它们对齐，支持你在组织内的职业发展。

As Daniel Pink notes in his book Drive, "Researchers found greater job satisfaction among employees whose bosses offered 'autonomy support.'" If you're looking to help your employees find that greater satisfaction, flourish, and fulfill the promise of the Agile Manifesto, consider starting up autonomy-support meetings.

正如 Daniel Pink 在《Drive》一书中指出的：「研究人员发现，老板提供『自主支持』的员工工作满意度更高。」如果你想帮你的员工找到更高的满意度、蓬勃发展、实现敏捷宣言的承诺，考虑开始自主支持会议吧。
